figureAlts.figure9.gif: Ciara is interested in exploring the heights of women's tennis players. She has collected a sample of 100 heights of professional women's tennis players and wants to use this sample to estimate the true interquartile range (IQR) of all heights of professional women's tennis players. The interquartile range (IQR) is defined as IQR equals 75th percentile minus 25th percentile.
